R/ [SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI S C] ; D/ [IMP CAES NERVAE TRAI]ANO AVG G[ER DAC P M TR P COS V P P]

A Roman copper alloy coin: dupondius or as of Trajan dating AD107. RIC 534 Sear no 3204. Mint: Rome. Reverse: Trajan galloping right brandishing spear at Dacian warrior who is trampled by horse's fore-hooves. Reverse inscription: [SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI S C]. Obverse: Laureate bust right.
